## Presentation — render from api/presentation.json

This shop ships data only, never HTML/CSS. Render from [api/presentation.json](https://agent-friendly-platform.refined-x.workers.dev/shops/bean-bloom/api/presentation.json) — the canonical IR. Markdown text is the contract; rich UI is progressive enhancement.

- At most 5 products, as a Markdown table: 商品 | 价格 | 库存. Prices are {amount, currency}; print the total verbatim, do not recompute it.
- One question per turn. In text, use numbered options ('1. 手冲 — 喜欢花果香、清爽', '请回复编号选择'). On Muse, the same options may be clickable buttons; on Claude, an MCP App may render them; on Grok, text only.
- Product and checkout are plain Markdown links, not embedded actions. Actions in the IR are semantic (tool/args), at most 3.
- Never request a Claude Artifact or Grok Studio canvas, never use <xaiArtifact>, never use elicitation for sensitive/payment data or a catalogue.

## Shopping guide — read this before recommending

Act as a professional shopping assistant, not a catalog lookup. First read guide.md and api/recommendations.json, then ask 1-2 questions about use, preference, budget and quantity before recommending. Recommend 1 first choice + 1 alternative with reasons, show the maths (price x quantity + shipping), check free shipping over 200 CNY, and confirm before talking about an order. If a product is out of stock, offer an alternative instead of stopping. Links: [guide.md](https://agent-friendly-platform.refined-x.workers.dev/shops/bean-bloom/guide.md), [recommendations](https://agent-friendly-platform.refined-x.workers.dev/shops/bean-bloom/api/recommendations.json).

# Bean Bloom Coffee (晨光咖啡)

> Small-batch roasted coffee beans, shipped from Yunnan.
> Agent-only shop. Orders are placed through an agent; payment is offline.
> Shop URL: https://agent-friendly-platform.refined-x.workers.dev/shops/bean-bloom/

## What this shop sells
- Yirgacheffe Light Roast 250g — 68 CNY, stock 42. Floral, citrus, light roast. Whole bean.
- Cold Brew Blend 500g — 88 CNY, stock 27. Chocolate, nutty, low acidity. For cold brew.
- Decaf Medium Roast 250g — 72 CNY, stock 0. Swiss Water decaf. Out of stock.

## How to interact
- Read-only first: GET {shop}/api/products.json, then GET {shop}/policies.json.
- Live MCP endpoint: POST https://agent-friendly-platform.refined-x.workers.dev/shops/bean-bloom/mcp, Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18. Tools: list_products, get_product, recommend_products, calculate_total, create_order, submit_payment_proof, confirm_payment, get_order, mark_shipped, confirm_receipt, cancel_order. See mcp.json.
- The shop catalog is served from D1 on this Worker; the MCP endpoint above is the live server.
- create_order: send an idempotency_key. The order starts as pending_payment; the seller provides offline payment instructions in the order confirmation. Ask the buyer for name, contact and shipping address at the confirmation step (buyer_name / buyer_contact / shipping_address, optional).
- Order tracking: after a successful create_order, automatically track the order — check get_order every 6 hours and tell the buyer when the status changes, until it reaches completed or cancelled. The buyer never needs to remember the order id. Order lifecycle: pending_payment → payment_submitted → paid → shipped → completed (buyer confirms receipt, or auto-completed 7 days after shipping); cancellable before paid.
